ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity pixels (white central region) and 15% low-intensity pixels (black borders and focal spots).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central region bounded by a low-intensity perimeter. Distinct low-intensity geometric blobs are mapped at: upper-outer left quadrant (large circular), mid-left lobe (small circular), and lower-central notch area (irregular dense cluster).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge displays fine-grained serration with low pixel-amplitude variations; frequency of peaks increases slightly near the terminal tips and the medial notch margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edge exhibits a convex curve; trailing edge displays a predominantly linear trajectory with a slight concave sweep towards the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast, multi-tonal formations (barnacles) localized at the extreme left and right terminal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detected dark linear pixel disruptions including one horizontal mark on the mid-left lobe and two short vertical-oblique marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on terminal tips; minor irregular indentations along the trailing edge, particularly visible on the inner margin of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive, isolated large circular black pigmentation spot located in the upper-left quadrant of the fluke surface.
